## Summary

What does this PR change, and why?

## Related work item

Closes/Refs: #US-XXX / #TASK-XXX (link the [user story](../user-stories/) or [task](../tasks/))

## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new feature
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `refactor` — no functional change
- [ ] `test` — test-only change
- [ ] `chore` — tooling/config
- [ ] `ci` — CI/workflow change

## How this was tested

- [ ] Unit tests added/updated
- [ ] Integration tests added/updated (if applicable)
- [ ] AI prompt fixtures run (if a prompt/agent changed) — see [TESTING_STRATEGY.md](../docs/TESTING_STRATEGY.md#ai-prompt-testing)
- [ ] Manually verified locally

Describe what you ran and observed:

## Documentation

- [ ] Relevant docs updated in this PR (architecture / agent spec / prompt / API), or not applicable

## Checklist

- [ ] Follows [CODING_STANDARDS.md](../docs/CODING_STANDARDS.md)
- [ ] No secrets or real client/contract data committed (see [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md))
- [ ] CI passes (lint, type-check, tests)
- [ ] Self-reviewed the diff before requesting review
